g.text: Residue of chain A, numbered as in the structure file
An interface has no centre. The residues of chain A that touch chain B stand
in a column, as boxes, in the order of the sequence; a dotted line stands for
residues in between that do not; those of chain B around it. A line is a pair of
residues, at the shortest of its contacts of one kind.
All 6 residues of chain A at the interface are shown, with 16 contacts.
